//: A file that holds credentials and nothing else. Point at it from config.json with "secrets": "secrets.json". Never share or commit it (it is already in .gitignore). Normally you register these from the settings screen, so there is no need to write this by hand
//remote_token: The remote UI's token. Setting it keeps the URL the same, so phones do not have to pair again (32 characters or more recommended)
//tokens: The values themselves. Inside a desk in config.json they are referred to as "@name". Scripts cannot read them. Keys for notification destinations and model connections are filed under notify/<desk id>/... , provider/<desk id>/<connection name> and git/<desk id>/<git account name>
